items: The Crown Jewel of Seacrest Beach is calling to you. Located on the best lot in the neighborhood, its just a short walk to the beach, swimming, shopping, gourmet dining and nature trails. This gorgeous property features oversized rooms throughout, beds for 16, huge indoor outdoor living and kitchen areas with one of the largest kitchen islands you'll ever see, a kids bunk retreat room, and parking for 8 vehicles. The walking trails in the backyard lead to Alys and Rosemary Beach.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

reviews.author: Alexandra K.
reviews.label: Excellent
reviews.text: We absolutely loved staying at this home! It was even more beautiful in person than it was in the pictures! The location was great- a seven minute walk to Rosemary Beach and about a 10 minute walk to Alys beach. We had six kids with us ranging from eight months old to six years old, and it was perfect for two families of 10! Plenty of space and awesome bunkbeds for the kids. Grant was a great communicator. Access to pool and beach. We will definitely be staying here again!!

items:
We’ve got three amazing balconies. The first is right by the living room and features an outdoor kitchen with a stove, sink and mini fridge ready to enjoy some evening cookouts.
The second balcony is located in front with a living area and ping pong table. That’s accessed from the hallway door and also from the front second story bedroom.
We’ve got a third patio off the rear of the house in the primary bedroom that features a secluded forest view and a nice swing for two.

We do have a high chair available as well as a pack n play.
We have a dining table that seats 8 and another 6 can sit around the kitchen island.
